subject: DI04000241

body.en:
Start with the situation

A rectangular block needs a flat face, a slot and side shoulders. A rotating multi-edge cutter can generate these features.

Definition / principle

Milling removes material with a rotating cutter while controlled relative feed brings successive teeth into engagement.

Understand why

Unlike continuous single-point turning, each tooth often enters and leaves the cut, creating intermittent loads.

Application / illustration

Face milling, end milling, slab milling and slot milling differ in active edges, cutter axis and generated feature.

Common mistake / conditions

Cutter rotation direction alone does not establish up/down milling; compare local tooth velocity with work feed.

Is table feed the same as feed per tooth?

No. Table feed equals tooth feed times teeth count times RPM.
body.gu:
પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂઆત

Rectangular blockમાં flat face,slot,side shoulders જોઈએ.Rotating multi-edge cutterથી આ features બને.

Definition / Principle

Millingમાં rotating cutter material દૂર કરે;controlled relative feedથી successive teeth engage થાય.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Continuous single-point turningથી જુદું,દરેક tooth cutમાં આવે-જાય,intermittent loads બને.

Application / ઉદાહરણ

Face,end,slab,slot millingમાં active edges,cutter axis,feature જુદાં હોય.

Common Mistake / શરતો

ફક્ત rotation directionથી up/down નક્કી નહિ;local tooth velocityને work feed સાથે compare કરો.

Table Feed,Feed per Tooth Same છે?

ના.Table feed=tooth feed×teeth count×RPM.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A vertical-spindle mill provides controlled table motions; universal features depend on the stated model.

Construction:part and purpose

Base and column provide a rigid frame and guide support.

A knee/saddle/table arrangement provides vertical, cross and longitudinal positioning on the conventional model.

A vertical head carries spindle bearings and its tool interface.

Head swivel/tilt or additional angular facilities increase capability only where provided.

Quill motion, where fitted, provides limited axial spindle travel distinct from knee travel.

Feed drives/handwheels move axes; stops and graduated readouts assist positioning.

Guards, coolant/chip management and positive cutter/workholding complete the system.

Working:flow and reason

Locate the work on an established datum using suitable vice, clamps or fixtures.

Select a compatible cutter, holder and correct cutting direction under supervision.

The spindle rotates the cutter at the selected speed.

Position axes to establish width and depth without exceeding machine/tool capacity.

Table feed brings material through successive cutting teeth.

A planned pass sequence removes stock and preserves a finishing allowance where needed.

Stop safely for inspection; check dimensions, finish and burrs against the drawing.

Common mistake / conditions

The syllabus calls this universal vertical; do not automatically assign every universal-horizontal table feature to it. Check actual model facilities.
body.gu:

Vertical-spindle mill controlled table motions આપે;universal features stated model પર આધારિત છે.

Construction:ભાગ અને કામ

Base,column rigid frame,guide support આપે.

Conventional modelમાં knee/saddle/tableથી vertical,cross,longitudinal positioning મળે.

Vertical head spindle bearings,tool interface રાખે.

Head swivel/tilt કે angular facility હોય ત્યાં જ capability વધે.

Quill fitted હોય ત્યાં limited axial spindle travel આપે;તે knee travelથી જુદું છે.

Feed drives/handwheels axes ચલાવે;stops,graduated readouts positioningમાં મદદ કરે.

Guards,coolant/chip management,positive cutter/workholding system પૂર્ણ કરે.

Working:Flow અને કારણ

Suitable vice,clamps,fixtureથી established datum પર work locate કરો.

Compatible cutter,holder,correct cutting direction supervised રીતે પસંદ કરો.

Spindle selected speed પર cutter ફેરવે.

Capacityની અંદર axes positionથી width,depth establish કરો.

Table feed materialને successive cutting teethમાંથી પસાર કરે.

Planned passes stock દૂર કરે,જરૂરી finishing allowance રાખે.

Inspection માટે safely stop કરો;drawing સામે dimensions,finish,burrs જુઓ.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Syllabusમાં universal vertical છે;દરેક universal-horizontal table feature તેને આપમેળે ન આપો.Actual model facilities જુઓ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

The horizontal spindle commonly drives an arbor-supported cutter for peripheral cutting.

Construction:part and purpose

Base and column carry the horizontal spindle and structural loads.

The knee supports a saddle and table on suitable guideways.

An arbor transmits spindle torque to mounted cutters.

Overarm and arbor support limit arbor bending for the fitted arrangement.

Correct spacers, keys and retaining arrangements locate cutters as specified.

Workholding devices attach to table slots with adequate support and clearance.

Feed mechanisms, guards and lubrication support controlled operation.

Working:flow and reason

Plan the datum, holding and cutter arrangement for the required feature.

The spindle drives the arbor and mounted cutter.

Table positioning establishes the engagement and depth.

Feed moves the clamped work relative to peripheral cutter teeth.

Slab milling generates a broad plane; side/straddle/gang arrangements serve other features.

Chips leave interrupted tooth engagements; approved guards/control manage hazards.

After a safe stop, inspect the result and account for cutter/arbor deflection if needed.

Common mistake / conditions

Unsupported overhang increases deflection; holder capacity and machine-specific assembly instructions govern the setup.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Horizontal spindle સામાન્ય રીતે arbor-supported cutterથી peripheral cutting કરે.

Construction:ભાગ અને કામ

Base,column horizontal spindle,structural loads લે.

Knee suitable guideways પર saddle,table support કરે.

Arbor spindle torque mounted cutters સુધી પહોંચાડે.

Overarm,arbor support fitted arrangementમાં bending ઘટાડે.

Specified spacers,keys,retaining arrangements cutter locate કરે.

Workholding devices table slotsમાં adequate support,clearance સાથે જોડાય.

Feed mechanisms,guards,lubrication controlled operationમાં મદદ કરે.

Working:Flow અને કારણ

Required feature માટે datum,holding,cutter arrangement plan કરો.

Spindle arbor,mounted cutterને drive કરે.

Table positioning engagement,depth નક્કી કરે.

Feed clamped workને peripheral teeth સામે ચલાવે.

Slab milling broad plane આપે;side/straddle/gang arrangements બીજા features બનાવે.

Interrupted engagementથી chips છૂટે;approved guards/control hazards સંભાળે.

Safe stop પછી result inspect કરો,જરૂર પડે cutter/arbor deflection ધ્યાનમાં લો.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Unsupported overhangથી deflection વધે;holder capacity,machine-specific instructions મુજબ setup થાય.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Describe travel, envelope, spindle interface, speed/feed ranges and power—not just table length.

Understand why

Illustrative vertical-mill data:table900×250mm, XYZ travel600/250/400mm, speed80–2000rev/min, power3kW.

Spindle-to-table clearance and throat limit work/fixture/cutter stack height and reach.

Vertical/horizontal describes spindle orientation; universal features and head/table swivels must be specified separately.

Axis labels follow the machine convention; always define which motion and reference your diagram uses.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

ફક્ત table length નહિ,travel,envelope,spindle interface,speed/feed ranges,power લખો.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Illustrative vertical-mill data:table900×250mm,XYZ travel600/250/400mm,speed80–2000rev/min,power3kW.

Spindle-to-table clearance,throat work/fixture/cutter stack height,reach મર્યાદિત કરે.

Vertical/horizontal spindle orientation બતાવે;universal features,head/table swivel અલગ જણાવો.

Axis labels machine convention મુજબ;diagramની motion,reference સ્પષ્ટ કરો.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Cutter shape and active cutting edges determine the accessible surface.

Understand why

Slab cutters cut mainly at the periphery; face mills machine planes with peripheral/face edges.

End mills cut sides and ends; not every end mill is centre-cutting or suited to direct plunging.

Side-and-face cutters make slots/shoulders; slitting saws make narrow slots within stiffness limits.

Angle/form cutters make angular or profiled features; T-slot and dovetail cutters need suitable preliminary access cuts.

Helical teeth give progressive engagement; choose tooth count and chip space for material, engagement and evacuation.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Cutter shape,active edges accessible surface નક્કી કરે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Slab cutter મુખ્યત્વે peripheryથી;face mill peripheral/face edgesથી planes બનાવે.

End mill side,end cut કરે;દરેક end mill centre-cutting કે direct plunging માટે નથી.

Side-and-face cutter slots/shoulders;slitting saw stiffness limitsમાં narrow slots બનાવે.

Angle/form cutters angular/profile features;T-slot,dovetail cutters માટે suitable preliminary access cuts જોઈએ.

Helical teeth progressive engagement આપે;tooth count,chip space material,engagement,evacuation મુજબ લો.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A tooth has rake, clearance and cutting-edge geometry, but reference directions depend on cutter type.

Understand why

Radial/axial rake influence chip formation, cutting force and edge strength.

Primary clearance behind the cutting edge prevents rubbing; too much relief weakens support.

Helix angle inclines teeth around the body and can generate axial thrust.

Pitch is spacing between adjacent teeth; runout causes unequal tooth loading and can spoil finish.

Identify these on a suitable cutter drawing rather than transferring the ASA single-point signature unchanged.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Toothમાં rake,clearance,edge geometry હોય,પણ references cutter type પર આધારિત છે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Radial/axial rake chip formation,force,edge strengthને અસર કરે.

Edge પાછળ primary clearance rubbing અટકાવે;વધુ reliefથી support નબળું પડે.

Helix angle teethને body આસપાસ incline કરે,axial thrust આપી શકે.

Pitch adjacent teethનું spacing છે;runout unequal loading,ખરાબ finish આપે.

Suitable cutter drawing પર ઓળખો;ASA single-point signature સીધી copy ન કરો.

h.en: 3.1.7 Up and down milling:why direction matters
h.gu: 3.1.7 Up અને Down Milling:Direction કેમ જરૂરી?

body.en:
Definition / principle

Compare cutter velocity at the engagement zone with table feed.

Understand why

Up/conventional milling has opposite directions; ideal chip thickness grows from nearly zero to a maximum.

Down/climb milling has the same directions; ideal chip thickness falls from maximum toward zero.

Up milling initially rubs before forming a chip and can tend to lift the work in common slab arrangements.

Down milling can improve engagement/finish but may pull the table into the cutter if backlash is uncontrolled.

Use climb milling only where machine stiffness, backlash control, holding and approved procedure permit; it is not universally safer or better.

Which starts with maximum chip thickness?

Ideal down/climb milling in the stated peripheral model.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Engagement zoneની cutter velocityને table feed સામે જુઓ.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Up/conventionalમાં directions વિરુદ્ધ;ideal chip thickness લગભગ zeroથી maximum સુધી વધે.

Down/climbમાં directions same;ideal chip thickness maximumથી zero તરફ ઘટે.

Upમાં શરૂઆતમાં rubbing પછી chip બને;common slab arrangementમાં work lift થવાની tendency હોય.

Down milling engagement/finish સુધારે,પણ uncontrolled backlash હોય તો tableને cutterમાં ખેંચી શકે.

Machine stiffness,backlash control,holding,approved procedure મંજૂર કરે ત્યાં જ climb milling;હંમેશાં safer/better નહિ.

Maximum Chip Thicknessથી કયું શરૂ થાય?

Stated peripheral modelમાં ideal down/climb milling.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Work location, resistance to force and tool retention must all be reliable.

Understand why

Plain/swivel/universal vices locate suitable work; parallels support datum faces without obstructing the cutter.

T-bolts, clamps, step blocks and fixtures secure awkward work; arrange supports to avoid bending it.

Collets/end-mill holders retain shank tools; arbors drive bore-type cutters; face-mill adapters carry suitable face mills.

Tapers, drawbars, keys, clamping torques and reach must match the approved holder system.

Never assume a drill chuck is an acceptable milling holder; side load and tool pull-out require appropriate retention.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Work location,force resistance,tool retention બધું reliable જોઈએ.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Plain/swivel/universal vice suitable work locate કરે;parallels datum support આપે,cutterને અવરોધ્યા વગર.

T-bolts,clamps,step blocks,fixtures awkward work secure કરે;supportથી bending ટાળો.

Collet/end-mill holder shank tools પકડે;arbor bore-type cutters;face-mill adapter suitable face mill રાખે.

Tapers,drawbars,keys,clamping torques,reach approved holder system સાથે match થવાં જોઈએ.

Drill chuckને milling holder ન માનો;side load,tool pull-out માટે appropriate retention જોઈએ.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A worm-and-wheel dividing head converts controlled crank turns into small work rotations.

Understand why

For a stated40:1 head,40crank turns rotate work once; forN equal divisions, crank movement=40/N.

Split the fraction into whole turns plus a fraction; choose a hole circle making the fraction an integer number of spaces.

Sector arms help repeat the spacing but do not change the worm ratio.

Count hole spaces moved, not both starting and ending holes; use the approved direction/backlash-control method.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Worm-wheel dividing head controlled crank turnsને નાના work rotationsમાં ફેરવે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Stated40:1 headમાં40crank turnsથી work એકવાર ફરે;N divisions માટે crank movement=40/N.

Fractionને whole turns અને remainderમાં વહેંચો;remainder integer spaces આપે તે hole circle લો.

Sector arms spacing repeat કરવામાં મદદ કરે,પણ worm ratio બદલતા નથી.

Moved hole spaces ગણો,starting/ending holes બન્ને નહિ;approved direction/backlash-control method લો.

body.en:
Given and model

Assume40:1 head and available18-hole,21-hole circles.

Step-by-step solution

  1. For24:40/24=1+2/3 turns
  2. 2/3×18=12 spaces on18-hole circle; move1turn+12spaces
  3. For28:40/28=1+3/7 turns
  4. 3/7×21=9spaces on21-hole circle; move1turn+9spaces

Common mistake / conditions

The circle must actually exist on the supplied plate; do not invent a required hole circle.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

40:1 head તથા available18-hole,21-hole circles લો.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. For24:40/24=1+2/3 turns
  2. 2/3×18=12 spaces on18-hole circle;move1turn+12spaces
  3. For28:40/28=1+3/7 turns
  4. 3/7×21=9spaces on21-hole circle;move1turn+9spaces

Common Mistake / શરતો

Supplied plateમાં circle ખરેખર હોવો જોઈએ;જરૂરી hole circle invent ન કરો.

h.en: 3.1.11 RPM, table feed, MRR and cutting time

body.en:
Given and model

Face millD80mm, z8teeth, Vc100m/min, fz.1mm/tooth, width50mm, depth2mm, total feed travel130mm; select N400rev/min.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Calculated N=1000×100/(pi×80)=397.887rev/min
  2. At N400:actual Vc=pi×80×400/1000=100.531m/min
  3. Table feed vf=.1×8×400=320mm/min
  4. Steady rectangular MRR=50×2×320=32000mm³/min
  5. Time=130/320=.40625min=24.375s

Common mistake / conditions

Use the supplied total travel; do not add approach twice. Allowances depend on cutter engagement and pass layout.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

Face mill D80mm,z8teeth,Vc100m/min,fz.1mm/tooth,width50mm,depth2mm,total travel130mm;N400rev/min લો.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. Calculated N=1000×100/(pi×80)=397.887rev/min
  2. At N400:actual Vc=pi×80×400/1000=100.531m/min
  3. Table feed vf=.1×8×400=320mm/min
  4. Steady rectangular MRR=50×2×320=32000mm³/min
  5. Time=130/320=.40625min=24.375s

Common Mistake / શરતો

Supplied total travel લો;approach બમણું ન ઉમેરો.Allowances cutter engagement,pass layout પર આધારિત છે.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A calculated feed is only useful when teeth can engage without rubbing, overload or collision.

Understand why

Define feature depth, width, entry, exit and collision envelope before choosing passes.

Compare roughing MRR/power with rigidity and holder limits; leave controlled finishing stock where needed.

Chatter can arise from excessive overhang, weak clamping, tool wear or unsuitable engagement; changing RPM alone is not a complete diagnosis.

State real machine specifications and measurements only when observed; sample planning is not evidence of a completed milling job.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Teeth rubbing,overload,collision વગર engage થાય ત્યારે જ calculated feed ઉપયોગી છે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Pass પહેલાં feature depth,width,entry,exit,collision envelope નક્કી કરો.

Roughing MRR/powerને rigidity,holder limits સામે જુઓ;જરૂરી finishing stock રાખો.

Chatter excessive overhang,weak clamping,wear,engagementથી થાય;ફક્ત RPM change complete diagnosis નથી.

Observed હોય તે જ real specifications/readings લખો;sample planning completed milling jobનો પુરાવો નથી.

title.en: 3.2 From cutter selection to a workable pass

h.en: 3.2.1 Face, slot, straddle and gang milling

body.en:
Definition / principle

The operation name describes the cutter arrangement and feature, not just the spindle orientation.

Understand why

Face milling produces a plane principally normal to cutter axis; slab milling uses peripheral teeth with axis parallel to the generated plane.

Slot milling produces a groove using a suitable end/slot/side cutter; slot width and evacuation constrain the tool.

Straddle milling uses two side cutters to machine parallel sides; spacer accuracy and cutter setup control separation.

Gang milling combines cutters on one arbor to machine several features in a pass; combined load and clearance must remain acceptable.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Operationનું નામ cutter arrangement,feature બતાવે,ફક્ત spindle orientation નહિ.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Face millingમાં plane મુખ્યત્વે cutter axisને normal;slab millingમાં axis generated planeને parallel અને peripheral teeth કામ કરે.

Slot milling suitable end/slot/side cutterથી groove આપે;slot width,evacuation limits નક્કી કરે.

Straddle millingમાં બે side cutters parallel sides બનાવે;spacers/setup separation control કરે.

Gang millingમાં એક arbor પર cuttersથી એક passમાં અનેક features બને;combined load,clearance acceptable જોઈએ.

h.en: 3.2.2 Tool geometry sketch and chip-load reasoning
h.gu: 3.2.2 Tool Geometry Sketch અને Chip-loadનો તર્ક

body.en:
Definition / principle

A cutter tooth needs a rake face, relief and chip space even when the overall cutter is circular.

Understand why

Label cutter diameter, cutting edge, rake face, flank, radial rake and clearance on a suitable local tooth view.

Cutting speed uses cutter diameter; tooth feed must include number of active specified teeth through vf=fz z N.

Doubling tooth count at unchangedfz andRPM doubles calculated table feed, but machine power, chip clearance and engagement may prevent that change.

Too low a tooth load may rub instead of cut; do not reduce feed indefinitely to solve every finish problem.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Overall cutter circular હોય તો પણ toothને rake face,relief,chip space જોઈએ.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Suitable local tooth viewમાં diameter,cutting edge,rake face,flank,radial rake,clearance label કરો.

Cutting speedમાં cutter diameter;vf=fz z Nમાં specified teeth count લેવું પડે.

Same fz,RPMમાં teeth બમણાં કરવાથી calculated feed બમણું;પણ power,chip clearance,engagementથી તે શક્ય ન હોય.

બહુ ઓછા tooth loadથી cuttingની જગ્યાએ rubbing થાય;દરેક finish problem માટે feed અનંત ઘટાડશો નહિ.

body.en:
Given and model

D10mm, end mill4teeth, N1000, fz.04mm/tooth; slot width10mm, depth3mm, total travel80mm.

Step-by-step solution

  1. vf=.04×4×1000=160mm/min
  2. Steady MRR=10×3×160=4800mm³/min
  3. Time=80/160=.5min

Common mistake / conditions

Entry strategy, centre-cutting capability, chip evacuation and permitted full-slot engagement must be checked separately.

Does an index plate set the worm ratio?

No. The head transmission sets the ratio; holes subdivide crank turns.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

D10mm,end mill4teeth,N1000,fz.04mm/tooth;slot width10mm,depth3mm,total travel80mm.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. vf=.04×4×1000=160mm/min
  2. Steady MRR=10×3×160=4800mm³/min
  3. Time=80/160=.5min

Common Mistake / શરતો

Entry strategy,centre-cutting capability,chip evacuation,permitted full-slot engagement અલગ તપાસો.

Index Plate Worm Ratio નક્કી કરે?

ના.Head transmission ratio આપે;holes crank turnsના ભાગ પાડે.
